prompt.zh-TW: 阿凱說：「三張報表只是三張各自獨立的表格。」你想用一個例子說服他三張表其實互相連動。下列哪一個例子說得通？
prompt.en: Kai says the three statements are just three separate tables. You want one example that shows they are connected. Which of these examples makes the point?

text.zh-TW: 現金流量表算到最後的期末現金，和資產負債表上的現金是同一個數字
text.en: Closing cash on the statement of cash flows is the cash on the balance sheet

feedback.zh-TW: 說得通。這是現金流量表和資產負債表的連接點。
feedback.en: That works. It is the link between the statement of cash flows and the balance sheet.

text.zh-TW: 本期淨利流進未分配盈餘，留在資產負債表上
text.en: Profit for the period flows into unappropriated retained earnings on the balance sheet

short.zh-TW: 本期淨利流進未分配盈餘

feedback.zh-TW: 說得通。這是損益表和資產負債表的連接點。
feedback.en: That works. It is the link between the income statement and the balance sheet.

text.zh-TW: 損益表的營業收入等於資產負債表的資產總計
text.en: Revenue on the income statement equals total assets on the balance sheet

short.zh-TW: 營業收入等於資產總計

feedback.zh-TW: 你在找兩張表之間的連線，方向是對的。不過這兩個數字沒有這種關係：收入是一段期間賺到的，資產總計是某一天擁有的，通常差很多。
feedback.en: You are looking for a link between two statements, and that is the right idea. But no such relationship exists: revenue is what was earned over a period, total assets is what is owned on a day, and the two usually differ a lot.

explanation.zh-TW: 三張表之間有兩條最常用的連線：{{option:o_53v0}}把現金流量表接到資產負債表，{{option:o_kc37}}把損益表接到資產負債表。選哪一條都能說服阿凱；{{option:o_p9c3}}則不是真的連線。
explanation.en: Two links between the statements are used most often: {{option:o_53v0}} joins the statement of cash flows to the balance sheet, and {{option:o_kc37}} joins the income statement to the balance sheet. Either would convince Kai; {{option:o_p9c3}} is not a real link.
